verdict.rationale: Runloop serves a live llms.txt (probe returned HTTP 200) and markdown versions of its doc pages that point agents to that index. It also documents agent-oriented context: an "Add context about the Runloop API to your LLMs" tools page and downloadable Cursor .mdc rule files covering the SDK. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the llms.txt and AI-tools offering itself (e.g. llms-full.txt or coverage scope), and independent corroboration beyond the probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.runloop.ai/llms.txt
Add context about the Runloop API to your LLMs
We provide [Cursor rules] files (`.mdc`) that give your AI assistant context about the Runloop SDK
